facts: PropertyMembers owns ordered nonzero unique physical membership with private vector and checked Serde. PropertySupportSurface validation compares treatment/member cardinality, mesh and limit tolerance, region/outlines bounds, finite topology/grade and floor bindings. These are connected admission relationships, not evidence every mutable sibling path is sealed (adopted ROOT-ADM-F010 remains).

FloorBearing validates actual building ID and disjoint conforming regions. Floor datum/coverage checks compare independent measured mesh support with authored expected elevation, preserving tolerance allowance rather than forcing expected from observed geometry. Edge-key zero normalization is specific partition identity policy, not general loss of signed-zero numerical semantics.

FloorRegion holds cached projected outline and original admission wire provenance privately; every constructor/Deserialize derives outline from admission and no mutable accessor provided. Serializing source admission is deliberate reconstruction authority, not arbitrary duplicate writable geometry. Scene-grounding producer verifies full source/layout equality before selecting support, publishes bound projection then validates. Consumer validates bindings and reconstructs same support from unchanged geographic context; it does not freely reselect property floor. Supported terrain/ground/buildings represent distinct stage products; source-dependent cache mutation risks remain tied to actual visibility and later operations.
